mapper.select: SELECT * FROM settings_llm ORDER BY name
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM settings_llm WHERE id = #{id})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settings_llm (id, name, protocol, provider, base_url, model, key) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{protocol}, #{provider}, #{baseUrl}, #{model}, #{key})
mapper.select: UPDATE settings_llm SET name = COALESCE(#{name}, name), protocol = COALESCE(#{protocol}, protocol), provider = COALESCE(#{provider}, provider), base_url = COALESCE(#{baseUrl}, base_url), model = COALESCE(#{model}, model), key = COALESCE(#{key}, key) WHERE id = #{id} RETURNING *
